W tej scenie nagranie to fragment WLASNEGO PRZEDSTAWIENIA TEATRALNEGO Symmetry ('Dziewczyna Patrzaca w Gwiazdy', ds93-96), przypadkiem zarejestrowany - NIE zwiazany z watkiem Dirka/Wirmana z batch_20 (inne nagranie, inna tresc, ten sam mechanizm). Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: The sailcloth has sentimental value to her.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Żaglowe płótno ma dla niej sentymentalną wartość.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: She didn't like the look of the cauldron.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Nie podobał jej się wygląd kotła.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Why did Symmetry end up using the sailcloth?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Czemu Symmetry ostatecznie użyła żaglowego płótna?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: (naglowek wyboru)

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: It is... entirely possible that the Captain was set upon by a curse.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: To... całkiem możliwe, że Kapitan padł ofiarą klątwy.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Mortuga asked her to keep the cauldron covered up.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Mortuga poprosił ją, żeby trzymała kocioł zakryty.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: The sailcloth has sentimental value to her.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Żaglowe płótno ma dla niej sentymentalną wartość.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: She didn't like the look of the cauldron.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Nie podobał jej się wygląd kotła.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: [i]'Symmetry, all I ask is that you keep the sailcloth on the cauldron'.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: [i]'Symmetry, proszę cię tylko o to, żebyś zostawiła żaglowe płótno na kotle'.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: I wonder why she [h]needed[/h] a double, though -  this isn't a [i]mirror[/i] trick like before.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Zastanawiam się jednak, czemu [h]potrzebowała[/h] sobowtóra - to nie jest sztuczka z [i]lustrem[/i] jak poprzednio.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: The cabinet to the side...?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Szafka z boku...?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: When he saw my design for the poster, he had but one request;
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Gdy ujrzał mój projekt plakatu, miał tylko jedną prośbę;
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: When I was first let inside, the sailcloth was indeed draped over the cauldron.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Gdy po raz pierwszy wpuszczono mnie do środka, żaglowe płótno rzeczywiście spowijało kocioł.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: I hadn't realised he did not wish me to remove it...
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Nie zdawałam sobie sprawy, że nie chciał, bym je zdejmowała...
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: See - in the drawing, the cauldron's [i]uncovered.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Widzisz - na rysunku kocioł jest [i]odkryty.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Dang.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: A niech to.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: And see how on the poster, there's a little grim reaper guy? That's the person from the film.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: I widzisz, jak na plakacie jest taka mała kostucha? To ta postać z filmu.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: See? I knew she'd know about this-
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Widzisz? Wiedziałem, że będzie coś o tym wiedziała-
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: [i]Maybe I did.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: [i]Może i tak.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Let's just stick to the facts, shall we?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Trzymajmy się faktów, dobrze?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: So [h]that's[/h] why you went back to the Illusion Theatre...
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Więc [h]dlatego[/h] wróciłaś do Teatru Iluzji...
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: ...you feel bad that your trick was one of the last things he ever saw?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: ...czujesz się źle, że twoja sztuczka była jedną z ostatnich rzeczy, jakie zobaczył?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: I don't get why she couldn't just sit on the cauldron herself.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Nie rozumiem, czemu nie mogła po prostu sama usiąść na kotle.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Hang on - why does Sym [h]have[/h] a film of a grim reaper character? Where'd it [i]come[/i] from??
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Czekaj - czemu Sym w ogóle [h]ma[/h] film z postacią kostuchy? Skąd on się [i]wziął?[/i]?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: It's a scene from Dirk's movie.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: To scena z filmu Dirka.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Mortuga filmed it here on the submarine.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Mortuga nagrał to tutaj, na łodzi.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Sym filmed it as part of her old magic show.

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: What was Symmetry doing in the Illusion Theatre?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Co Symmetry robiła w Teatrze Iluzji?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: (naglowek wyboru)

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Jestem zgubiona!

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: -like a [i]magic act?[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: -jak pokaz [i]magiczny?[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: A [h]foolish[/h] act. A callous indulgence, through and through.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: [h]Głupi[/h] czyn. Bezduszne pobłażanie sobie, na wskroś.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: I... don't understand. Did it go [i]wrong?[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Ja... nie rozumiem. Coś poszło [i]źle?[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: I performed it perfectly.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Wykonałam to doskonale.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Then what's the problem?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: To w czym problem?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: She's gone quiet.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Zamilkła.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Oh - we found something else, too.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Och - znaleźliśmy też coś innego.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Sweet Sister Inanimate...
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Słodka Siostro Nieożywiona...
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: I implore you - leave her be. Her hands are clean!
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Błagam was - zostawcie ją w spokoju. Jej ręce są czyste!
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: The doll is a prop used in magic tricks.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Lalka to rekwizyt używany w sztuczkach magicznych.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: The doll was left behind by the murderer.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Lalkę zostawił morderca.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: The doll was a gift for Mortuga.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Lalka była prezentem dla Mortugi.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: How was the doll involved?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Jak lalka była w to zamieszana?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: (naglowek wyboru)

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Any trick where you'd need a [i]double[/i], obviously.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Każda sztuczka, w której potrzeba [i]sobowtóra,[/i] oczywiście.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Your magic act - [i]'Lady of the Looking Glass'[/i] - I don't claim to know exactly how it works,
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Twój pokaz magiczny - [i]'Dama Zwierciadła'[/i] - nie twierdzę, że wiem dokładnie, jak on działa,
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: -but as far as I can tell, you put the doll behind some kind of special mirror, and it acts as an identical double.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: -ale o ile się orientuję, umieszczasz lalkę za jakimś specjalnym lustrem, i działa ona jako identyczny sobowtór.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Lady of the Looking Glass is a thing of the past. I am no longer able to perform it.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Dama Zwierciadła to już przeszłość. Nie jestem już w stanie tego wykonać.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Because you don't have the special mirror?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Bo nie masz już specjalnego lustra?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: You misunderstand. I shall [h]never again[/h] perform this trick.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Źle rozumiecie. [h]Nigdy więcej[/h] nie wykonam tej sztuczki.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: But why not?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Ale czemu nie?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: ...och.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Because Sym and her doll are no longer identical.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Bo Sym i jej lalka nie są już identyczne.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Because she's lost one of the other props.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Bo zgubiła jeden z pozostałych rekwizytów.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Because someone banned her from performing it.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Bo ktoś zabronił jej to wykonywać.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Why can't Symmetry perform this trick anymore?

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: (naglowek wyboru)

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Because Sym and her doll are no longer identical.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Bo Sym i jej lalka nie są już identyczne.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Sweet Sister stays ever a fresh-face child.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Słodka Siostra pozostaje wiecznie dzieckiem o świeżej twarzy.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: No such fate is writ for me.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Taki los nie jest mi pisany.

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: So you can't use the doll [h]at all[/h] anymore?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Więc [h]w ogóle[/h] nie możesz już używać lalki?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Facing [i]away...?[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Odwrócona [i]tyłem...?[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Czemu tytuł byłby napisany na [i]żaglowym płótnie?[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: I'm pretty sure she used it during the magic act.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Jestem raczej pewna, że użyła go podczas pokazu magicznego.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: She draped it over the cauldron.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Zarzuciła je na kocioł.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: She wore it as a cloak.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Nosiła je jako pelerynę.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: She hung it up to use as a curtain.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Powiesiła je, żeby użyć jako zasłony.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: How did Sym use the sailcloth during the magic act?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Jak Sym użyła żaglowego płótna podczas pokazu magicznego?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: (naglowek wyboru)

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: She hung it up to use as a curtain.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Powiesiła je, żeby użyć jako zasłony.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: She wore it as a cloak.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Nosiła je jako pelerynę.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: She draped it over the cauldron.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Zarzuciła je na kocioł.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: -and given that you had to [i]keep[/i] it, you made use of it as a kind of [i]banner.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: -a skoro musiałaś je [i]zatrzymać,[/i] wykorzystałaś je jako coś w rodzaju [i]transparentu.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Before the Captain assented to me using that room, he'd been using it for storage.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Zanim Kapitan zgodził się, bym używała tego pokoju, on sam używał go jako magazynu.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Hm.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Hm.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: So what's The Star-Gazing Girl [i]about?[/i] What [i]happens[/i] in it?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Więc o czym właściwie [i]jest[/i] Dziewczyna Patrząca w Gwiazdy? Co się w niej [i]dzieje?[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: I... do not wish to speak on it.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Ja... nie życzę sobie o tym mówić.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: No? Well, we actually know quite a bit about it [i]already.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Nie? Cóż, w sumie [i]już[/i] sporo o tym wiemy.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en:
[i]The Star-Gazing Girl stares into the ink-black void.
[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl:
[i]Dziewczyna Patrząca w Gwiazdy wpatruje się w atramentowoczarną pustkę.
[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Pipe

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: [i]Upon her trembling lips, a question born. A forbidden query, of what may be, and what may not be.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: [i]Na jej drżących wargach, rodzi się pytanie. Zakazane pytanie, o to, co może być, i czego być nie może.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Pipe

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: [i]The void, unyielding to the girl's plight, stares back. It speaks;[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: [i]Pustka, nieugięta wobec błagania dziewczyny, spogląda w odpowiedzi. I przemawia;[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Pipe

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: [i]Close your eyes, my love. And be still. For this is the end and the beginning.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: [i]Zamknij oczy, moja miłości. I znieruchom. Bo to jest koniec i początek.[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Pipe

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: O! How can this be?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: O! Jakże to być może?
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Mariana Moon was in the bilge at the time. I guess the sound traveled down through the open vent.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Mariana Moon była wtedy w Zęzie. Chyba dźwięk doszedł w dół przez otwartą klapę wentylacyjną.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.en: Her pipe is a dictaphone.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.pl: Jej fajka to dyktafon.
Conversation/Symmetry 05 SUSPICION/Secti.speaker: Grimoire
